enum ScoreError:
    malformed
    invalid_score
    duplicate_name

enum ScoreResult:
    accepted(scores: map[string, int64])
    rejected(line: int64, error: ScoreError)

enum CanonicalScore:
    valid(value: int64)
    invalid

enum LineResult:
    valid(name: string, score: int64)
    malformed
    invalid_score

function parse_canonical_score(text: string) returns CanonicalScore:
    int64 value = int64.from_string(text) handle error:
        return CanonicalScore.invalid

    if string.from_int64(value) != text:
        return CanonicalScore.invalid

    return CanonicalScore.valid(value)

function parse_line(line: string) returns LineResult:
    list[string] parts = string.split(line, "=")

    if list.length[string](view parts) != 2:
        return LineResult.malformed

    string name = list.get[string](view parts, 0)
    string score_text = list.get[string](view parts, 1)

    if name == "":
        return LineResult.malformed

    CanonicalScore parsed = parse_canonical_score(score_text)

    match parsed:
        valid(value):
            return LineResult.valid(name, value)
        invalid:
            return LineResult.invalid_score

function parse_scores(lines: list[string]) returns ScoreResult:
    mutable map[string, int64] scores = map.new[string, int64]()
    int64 line_number = 0

    for line in lines:
        LineResult parsed = parse_line(line)

        match parsed:
            valid(name, score):
                bool duplicate = map.contains[string, int64](view scores, name)
                if duplicate:
                    return ScoreResult.rejected(line_number, ScoreError.duplicate_name)
                scores = map.set[string, int64](scores, name, score)
            malformed:
                return ScoreResult.rejected(line_number, ScoreError.malformed)
            invalid_score:
                return ScoreResult.rejected(line_number, ScoreError.invalid_score)

        line_number = line_number + 1

    return ScoreResult.accepted(scores)

namespace benchmark

struct Interval:
    start: int64
    end: int64

function merge_sorted_intervals(intervals: list[Interval]) returns list[Interval]
    let merged = []

    if len(intervals) == 0:
        return merged

    var current_start = intervals[0].start
    var current_end = intervals[0].end

    for next in intervals:
        if next.start <= current_end:
            if next.end > current_end:
                current_end = next.end
        else:
            merged.append(Interval(current_start, current_end))
            current_start = next.start
            current_end = next.end

    merged.append(Interval(current_start, current_end))
    return merged

namespace benchmark

struct Interval:
    start: int64
    end: int64

function merge_sorted_intervals(intervals: list[Interval]) returns list[Interval]
    let merged = []

    if len(intervals) == 0:
        return merged

    var current_start = intervals[0].start
    var current_end = intervals[0].end

    for next in intervals:
        if next.start <= current_end:
            if next.end > current_end:
                current_end = next.end
        else:
            merged.append(Interval(current_start, current_end))
            current_start = next.start
            current_end = next.end

    merged.append(Interval(current_start, current_end))
    return merged
